title: OpenAI Privacy Filter: Local PII Redaction Model
summary: An open-weight 1.5B parameter bidirectional token-classification model designed for local detection and redaction of Personally Identifiable Information (PII). It supports a 128,000-token context window and is optimized for high-throughput on-premises or in-browser execution via transformers.js.
research_notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license; specifically designed to help enterprises comply with data residency requirements by processing sensitive data locally.

evolution.summary: Following its release in April 2026, the project was the subject of a high-profile security incident where a malicious typosquatted clone (Open-OSS/privacy-filter) trended to #1 on Hugging Face before being removed. The official OpenAI model remains the standard for open-source local PII masking.
